Unicorn Dreams Farm. Zen Kneads. Holistic Health Advocate. I work on everything with a heart beat. Human, equine, canine, all animal massage and bodywork. Reiki Master Teacher and Practitioner (Usui, SSR, Karuna, Animal). Lover of all the woo. 

I am a  human Licensed and Certified Equine, Canine, and Small Animal  Massage Therapist/Bodyworker and Reiki Master Practitioner, I incorporate a variety of holistic modalities in my practice, including and not limited to cold laser, infrared and red light therapy, craniosacral, aromatherapy, energy work, bodywork, PEMF, SMRT, osteo techniques,myofascial, percussive instrument utilization, etc. 

“I work on everything with a heart beat”

Here at UDWT/Zen Kneads, we have a strong interest in wellness and creating a  healing environment, specifically as it relates to the beings we share our life and world with.. Of course, the journey doesn't stop here.. I am a forever student..... and every day I learn something new
